Subject: Your consumer complaint matter - CC/2526/2025

Dear Mr. Tiwari,

Thank you for meeting us on 18 October 2025 about your dispute with M/s Trident Builders Pvt Ltd. As we understand it, the flat was handed over with serious construction defects. The matter is listed before the Nashik District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission.

Our advice is to commission a structural audit report on the defects before the first hearing. Please collect photographs of the defects and a structural audit report and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of INR 7,17,00,000/-.

Regards,
Adv. Zubin Contractor

spans.text: Nashik District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission
